tasks.title: Invalidate descendants when reopening an exhausted task
tasks.objective: Ensure reopening an exhausted completed task escalates it through human resolution while still invalidating every transitive descendant atomically.
tasks.test_seam: A temporary repository with a completed three-task dependency graph and an upstream task at max attempts; use lifecycle operations to reopen, assert history and descendant resets, and test running/dirty descendant refusal before mutation.

tasks.title: Independently evaluate exhausted-task descendant invalidation
tasks.objective: Falsify atomic invalidation when reopening completed tasks both within and beyond the retry budget, including running and dirty descendant refusal.
tasks.test_seam: Use a clean temporary clone and adversarial probes for exhausted target attempts, transitive completion history, worktree cleanup, running descendants, and dirty descendants.
